name: Montage Deer Valley
positioning: Year-round mountain resort in Park City, Utah, with ski-in/ski-out access in winter and hiking and mountain biking in summer
best_for: Families who want ski school arranged at a Deer Valley Mountain office inside the hotel
Summer visitors who want hiking and mountain biking

facts.text: The hotel's address is 9100 Marsac Ave., Park City, Utah.
The resort's restaurants are near downtown Park City.
Apex Steak is one of the resort's restaurants.
Accommodation types include rooms, suites, cottages and residences.
The resort's spa is called Spa Montage.
Compass Sports can outfit guests with skis, boards and boots.
Summer activities at Montage Deer Valley include hiking and mountain biking.
Conde Nast Traveler lists golf, a pool, ski and a spa among the hotel's amenities.

highlights.text: Montage Deer Valley has ski-in/ski-out access to a ski resort in the winter.
Deer Valley Mountain has an office in the hotel, which makes arranging ski school easy.
Conde Nast Traveler reports that skis are ready by the time guests get downstairs.
The restaurant Slope Stream has fireside outdoor seating and mountainside views.

considerations.text: Activities change with the season: ski-in/ski-out access in winter, hiking and mountain biking in summer.
WhataHotel notes peak rates during ski season.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects its luxury mountain resort positioning.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Montage Deer Valley
